verdict.rationale: New Relic documents an interactive 'NerdGraph API explorer' for experimenting with its GraphQL API, which offers some runnable/interactive exploration, but there's no evidence of a full interactive API reference (e.g., OpenAPI/Swagger docs, which explicitly 404'd in the probe) covering REST endpoints or NRQL with runnable examples. missing for 10: a comprehensive interactive API reference (OpenAPI/Swagger) beyond NerdGraph, runnable code samples across languages, independent/hands-on confirmation of the explorer's usability.
